Definition: to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to lie down; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to lie, lie down, lie on; 1a2) to lodge; 1a3) to lie (of sexual relations); 1a4) to lie down (in death); 1a5) to rest, relax (fig); 1b) (Niphal) to be lain with (sexually); 1c) (Pual) to be lain with (sexually); 1d) (Hiphil) to make to lie down; 1e) (Hophal) to be laid
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
